title: feat: add Grok Imagine Video 1.5
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the new canonical `grok-imagine-video-1.5` with no aliases; the existing `grok-video-pro` model and route remain unchanged.
- Routes the new canonical to OpenRouter's exact `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5` model with no fallback or Pollinations GPU.
- Uses request-selected pricing for the new model: $0.08/s at 480p, $0.14/s at 720p, $0.25/s at 1080p, plus $0.01 per start image.
- Publishes the three resolutions and synchronized-audio output for 1.5 only.
- Validated all resolutions end to end in 66.19s–96.11s with exact billing and cache checks; focused alias/route/pricing tests and Gen typecheck pass.

gist.headline: Grok gets moving
gist.blurb: A new video flower just opened in the hive: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 now renders at 480p, 720p, or 1080p with synchronized audio. Polli checked the receipts, the cache, and every pixel path. Naturally.
gist.summary: Added the canonical `grok-imagine-video-1.5` video model, routed directly to OpenRouter’s `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5`, with 480p, 720p, and 1080p generation plus synchronized audio and request-selected pricing.
gist.impact: Builders can now generate Grok Imagine Video 1.5 clips with synchronized audio at $0.08/s for 480p, $0.14/s for 720p, or $0.25/s for 1080p, plus $0.01 for a start image.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Grok Imagine Video 1.5 as a cozy retro video studio: three small CRT monitors show the same blooming garden animation at 480p, 720p, and 1080p, while a warm waveform visibly syncs with the footage. Polli, wearing tiny director headphones, adjusts a film reel beside code-plants; the scene makes resolution choice and synchronized audio feel like carefully tending different flowers rather than a sterile settings panel.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and tiny director headphones, tending a retro garden video studio with three CRT monitors labeled in simple pixel text “480p”, “720p”, and “1080p”; each monitor shows a blooming flower animation with a softly glowing synchronized audio waveform. Lime green (#ecf874) is prominent in the monitor glow, flower pots, and code-plants, with warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach pastel gradients; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but emotionally warm.
